ios.desc:
Start learning to build projects using web technologies with just your iOS device. Expo Go is an educational developer tool for learning to create experiences with interactive gestures and graphics using JavaScript and React.

Note: some basic programming experience is recommended.
Technical specs: this version of Expo uses React Native 0.86

android.desc:
Start building rich experiences with just your Android device and your computer. Expo is a developer tool for creating experiences with interactive gestures and graphics, using JavaScript and React Native.

Create experiences using features such as 
- Camera
- Background Location
- Audio and Video 
- SQLite

To learn more visit https://expo.dev. Some programming experience is recommended.

By downloading and running this application, you are agreeing to our Terms of Service at https://expo.dev/terms.

quotes.text:
Hi there.

I am looking for someone to test my app, it's a small web app prototype to help event organizers build cross platform mobile apps, the main concept here is building blocks and cloud storage. With these two modules I can automate the whole process. I mean any kind of informative app without complex business logic can be built that way, I'm thinking about portfolios, small businesses apps, etc..

The idea is not new, similar services already exist but what I'm offering is very cheap compared to what you can found on the market. Also many features are still not implemented... like accent color, logo, etc.. The finished product of course will be an APK and IPA files.

The technology I'm using is google firebase for the cloud and react/react native for the web/mobile app, if you wish to learn more there's three easy steps:

1 - Sign up and add some data via your dashboard https://eventmob.herokuapp.com

2- Download expo app

iOs: https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id982107779

Playstore: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=host.exp.exponent&referrer=www

3- Scan this QR code to access the app

https://expo.io/@usfslk/event

4- Log in using the same account and explore your fresh new app

Adding data can takes time and that's why I created a prebuilt demo so you can do it in two steps:

Explore the app and makes some changes, you'll see the app get updated instantly.

Log in using these credentials:

email: blvckasvp@outlook.com
